title: Why do volcanoes really erupt?
description:
Volcanoes erupt when pressure from trapped magma and dissolved gas grows bigger than the rock above can hold. Follow the magma from a glowing chamber, up a narrow pipe, to the blast at the top.

#volcano #science #geology #shorts #earthscience

beats.sentence: Down there the heat is about one thousand degrees Celsius, hot enough to melt rock.

beats.sentence: Melted rock is lighter than solid rock, so it starts to rise.

beats.sentence: As the chamber fills, the pressure climbs and the walls squeeze tighter.

beats.sentence: The magma also holds dissolved gas, locked in like the fizz in a bottle.

beats.sentence: Think of a pressure cooker, where the needle keeps climbing until the lid gives way.
